name: cleanup-feature-flags
description: Remove a launched Harness FME feature flag from application code, keeping the treatment FME serves today, and open a pull request. Use when asked to remove a flag from code, hardcode the winning treatment after a rollout, or pay down flag debt for a specific flag. Do not use for finding stale flags (discover-feature-flags) or archiving and deleting flags in FME (manage-flag-lifecycle). Trigger phrases: remove flag from code, hardcode treatment, flag cleanup, flag debt, clean up feature flag.
